title: Sunday · the flats, April 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The flats with the pup at two: he takes all three tiers at a run, the two-one prints in a wild loop, a man far behind him with no leash. The scruff mark in the margin.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a small three-legged dog running across the flats at full tilt, prints in a loop behind.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog running full tilt across tidal mudflats with a looping trail of prints behind, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Run

panels.composition: Tier 2: the man far behind, small, no leash, hands in his pockets.

image.prompt: a small man far behind on wide mudflats with his hands in his pockets and no leash, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Far

panels.composition: Tier 3: the pup returned, mud to the chest, sitting at the man's boots, grinning.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog muddy to the chest sitting at a man's boots and looking up, watercolor

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk
